name: Way of the Drunken Master
summary: Monks who move with the unpredictable sway of a drunkard.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.summary: You gain proficiency in Performance and with brewer's supplies.

features.name: Drunken Technique
features.short: Flurry of Blows grants Disengage and +10 ft. speed.
features.summary: Whenever you use Flurry of Blows, you gain the benefit of the Disengage action and your walking speed increases by 10 ft. until the end of the turn.

features.name: Tipsy Sway
features.short: Stand up for 5 ft.; redirect a missed attack.
features.summary: Standing up from prone costs only 5 ft. of movement. When a creature misses you in melee, you can spend 1 ki point as a reaction to make it hit another creature within 5 ft. of you.

features.name: Drunkard's Luck
features.summary: When you make an ability check, attack roll or saving throw with disadvantage, you can spend 2 ki points to cancel the disadvantage.

features.name: Intoxicated Frenzy
features.short: Flurry of Blows can make up to five attacks.
features.summary: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can make up to three additional attacks (five total), as long as each targets a different creature.
